title: Market Close Report: NASDAQ Composite index closes at 7,051.98 down -63.90 points
text:
Shutterstock photo Wednesday's session closes with the NASDAQ Composite Index at 7,051.98. The total shares traded for the NASDAQ was over 2.41 billion.
Advancers stocks led declining by 1.1 to 1 ratio. There were 1585 advancers and 1439 decliners for the day. On the NASDAQ Stock Exchange 13 stocks reached a 52 week high and 29 those reaching lows totaled. The most active, advancers, decliners, unusual volume and most active by dollar volume can be monitored intraday on the Most Active Stocks page.
The NASDAQ 100 index closed down -1.26% for the day; a total of -83.96 points. The current value is 6,582.02. Microchip Technology Incorporated ( MCHP ) had the largest percent change down (-9.8%) while Hasbro, Inc. ( HAS ) had the largest percent change gain rising 8.83%.
The Dow Jones index closed down -.08% for the day; a total of -19.42 points. The current value is 24,893.35. Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) had the largest percent change down (-2.14%) while Boeing Company (The) ( BA ) had the largest percent change gain rising 2.11%.
